service-agentic-ai-workflows: A bounded assistant reads scoped evidence and prepares an exact proposal. A separate authority check verifies approval or policy before the backend commits and records the effect.
service-agentic-ai-workflows-catalog-pur: A versioned catalog feeds a purchase proposal with a fixed amount and cost centre. Approval is bound to the exact proposal, and the backend deduplicates repeat submissions.
service-agentic-ai-workflows-shipment-ex: Current shipment and contract evidence forms a versioned packet for dispatch. Late scans or conflicting carrier updates trigger a refresh before dispatch decides how to respond.
service-agentic-ai-workflows-clinic-admi: A scoped appointment request can produce a scheduling draft, subject to a slot recheck and staff approval. Clinical language is routed to the established staff pathway.
service-agentic-ai-workflows-incident-ev: Read-only telemetry is collected within service, environment, time and result limits. The evidence packet preserves timestamps and queries for engineers to evaluate a diagnostic proposal.
service-agentic-ai-workflows-editorial-r: An editorial packet connects claims to supporting sources and tracks image permissions. A separate authenticated editor checks the packet and decides whether to publish.
service-ai-security-iam: The control stack verifies the caller, scopes the tool, checks the resource at the service and records the effect separately from the model’s attempted action.
service-ai-security-iam-saas-tenant-retr: Three parallel checks enforce tenant scope on retrieval, cached answers and citation links, including after an access change.
service-ai-security-iam-banking-tool-del: Verified employee identity flows through scoped delegation and a document-service permission check before an internal draft is created.
service-ai-security-iam-health-record-ac: A scoped administrative lookup limits the record fields returned to the assistant and separately restricts diagnostic capture to reviewed metadata.
service-ai-security-iam-factory-assistan: The maintenance assistant reads approved, versioned manuals through a scoped adapter. Plant controls sit behind a separate credential boundary.
service-ai-security-iam-research-artifac: An experimental artifact is reviewed for provenance and integrity before publication, and deployment separately checks authorization and serving compatibility.
service-cloud-modernisation: Workload dependencies and constraints guide the architecture choice. A bounded migration pilot must meet the cutover and recovery checks before the source is retired.
service-cloud-modernisation-retail-order: Copy and catch up the retailer’s order data, reconcile state and export IDs, and move write authority only after the source writer is paused. The application keeps its modular structure.
service-cloud-modernisation-healthcare-a: A single authoritative scheduler resolves concurrent booking attempts. Administrative identity and reminder eligibility are tested separately, and the recovery exercise verifies restored slot ownership.
service-cloud-modernisation-manufacturin: Machine control stays local while a separate collector buffers reports during an uplink outage. After reconnection, stable event identities support replay and the dashboard marks late readings.
service-cloud-modernisation-university-r: The portal migration keeps federated sign-in and server-side access checks, tests the metadata path under semester bursts, and leaves restricted datasets in approved locations.
service-cloud-modernisation-insurance-do: A stable document ID connects a stored object, its workflow record, and its downstream acknowledgement. Reconciliation exposes incomplete pairs before the intake system moves.
service-cloud-native-infrastructure: An isolated Kubernetes lab carries one service from an inspectable artifact and scoped deployment through disruptions, recovery and independent validation.
service-cloud-native-infrastructure-saas: A versioned service template pins the image, scopes identity and exposes meaningful readiness. Learners check a real business response and restore the prior compatible artifact.
service-cloud-native-infrastructure-publ: The maintenance lab inspects replica spread, spare schedulable capacity and the disruption budget before a supported drain, then checks request outcomes.
service-cloud-native-infrastructure-heal: The network-policy lab checks that declared dependencies are reachable and prohibited connections are denied, then checks the normal application journey.
service-cloud-native-infrastructure-ener: One repeatable telemetry burst is applied to the baseline and candidate worker settings. Queue age, successful completions and CPU behavior are observed with competing work.
service-cloud-native-infrastructure-fina: Startup allows initialization, readiness governs traffic, and liveness detects a stuck handler. The lab checks slow start, dependency failure and rollback separately.
service-devops-automation: Reviewed source produces an artifact identified by digest. Verification stays attached to the artifact before bounded rollout and recovery checks.
service-devops-automation-banking-releas: Build provenance and test results identify one artifact digest. The release owner approves that exact digest for production promotion.
service-devops-automation-public-sector-: A verification gate checks the digest and build provenance against producer policy. An authorized artifact can enter deployment, while a signed artifact from an unapproved workflow is rejected.
service-devops-automation-logistics-safe: A bounded rollout stops progression when dispatch breaks. Operators restore the compatible release, then reconcile assignments against durable completion records.
service-devops-automation-healthcare-adm: An isolated release test suite checks synthetic administrative workflows for scheduling conflicts, access denials and delayed acknowledgements.
service-devops-automation-saas-developer: A versioned starter is tested as a complete onboarding path. A first deployment counts when the service is reachable, scoped, observable and has a tested removal path.
service-enterprise-middleware: The middleware lab cycles through observing a normal flow, injecting a contained failure, restoring service and proving the business result in an independent task.
service-enterprise-middleware-retail-ord: The committed order and outbox row share a transaction. The relay may deliver a duplicate, and the consumer records one reservation for the stable event identity.
service-enterprise-middleware-bank-payme: When the response times out, the payment status is unresolved. The lab compares retrying with the original idempotency key and looking up provider state before reconciliation.
service-enterprise-middleware-manufactur: Machine identity selects the partition. The consumer checks sequence gaps and late events, then replays into a separate projection for comparison before cutover.
service-enterprise-middleware-health-rec: The compatibility lab contrasts a new optional reminder field with a change to an existing status meaning. Old and new clients are tested against the supported runtime contracts.
service-enterprise-middleware-logistics-: The broker lab restores backlog processing, assigns an owner to the quarantined event and reconciles tracking state by stable shipment event identity.
service-finops-cost-governance: Reconcile the bill, allocate direct and shared costs by an explicit policy, and divide eligible cost by completed work. Reliability and quality checks govern optimization and rollback.
service-finops-cost-governance-saas-shar: The showback model allocates a reconciled platform pool using an agreed driver, keeps direct charges separate, and names unallocated costs. The allocations and residual tie back to the original bill.
service-finops-cost-governance-retail-co: The retailer compares total checkout cost and qualifying completed orders. A lower unit cost can coexist with a larger bill, so completion quality and service latency remain guardrails.
service-finops-cost-governance-genomics-: Stable run IDs tie compute and storage charges to research pipeline attempts. Retries and failures stay in cost, and only validated analyses in comparable input cohorts count as completions.
service-finops-cost-governance-media-tra: A transcode cost comparison separates output profiles and pipeline versions. Failed attempts stay in cost, and only outputs meeting the quality and deadline checks count in the denominator.
service-finops-cost-governance-financial: Reporting cost scenarios start with a fixed base and add cost per qualifying report within an agreed range. A capacity or licensing threshold sends the forecast to a revised scenario.
service-hands-on-lab-environments: A lab lifecycle starts from versioned inputs, verifies readiness, records evidence during a controlled fault, and proves reset and cleanup before reuse.
service-hands-on-lab-environments-univer: Local and remote learners use the same pinned Linux lab, wait for readiness, diagnose a seeded service fault and verify that reset restores the exercise.
service-hands-on-lab-environments-financ: A disposable CI lab separates contribution checks from the reviewed artifact build and restricted mock deployment, then verifies credential revocation.
service-hands-on-lab-environments-resear: Versioned code, dependencies and a recorded seed drive a clean runtime rebuild. A fixture check compares record identities and applies declared tolerances.
service-hands-on-lab-environments-manufa: A disposable edge VM accepts records during a simulated disconnection, verifies durable state after restart, and reconciles stable record identities after replay.
service-hands-on-lab-environments-public: A scoped browser-based lab preserves only declared work during interruption, checks the recovered deployment, and verifies workspace removal and credential expiry.
service-mlops-data-pipelines: Versioned inputs yield cutoff-correct features, and the release bundle binds model weights, preprocessing and serving settings so the producing version can be traced or restored.
service-mlops-data-pipelines-retail-inve: The historical path reconstructs eligible store-product features at the original cutoff. The operational path serves current eligible features with freshness information.
service-mlops-data-pipelines-factory-sen: Sensor processing preserves event identities and timing quality. Versioned windows retain missingness flags, and an interrupted run resumes from a checkpoint with stable output identities.
service-mlops-data-pipelines-financial-r: A forecast run ID points reviewers to approved source extracts and integrity checks, versioned transformations, the model artifact and reporting code.
service-mlops-data-pipelines-hospital-ca: Administrative staffing forecasts retain their original location, period, cutoff and version. Mature outcomes join to those forecasts, while pending labels and unresolved data gaps remain visible.
service-mlops-data-pipelines-energy-mode: A demand model release binds the artifact and versioned features built from demand records and the eligible weather vintage. Backfills run apart from the production deadline path.
service-predictive-analytics: Predictive analytics connects cutoff-correct evidence to an evaluated forecast, then applies a separately versioned decision rule and records which action was taken.
service-predictive-analytics-retail-dema: The seasonal baseline and candidate demand forecast use the same forecast horizon and later evaluation periods. Features include only promotions known before the cutoff.
service-predictive-analytics-telecom-ret: A churn risk model ranks accounts within a fixed review capacity. Testing whether a retention intervention changes outcomes requires a separate comparison.
service-predictive-analytics-equipment-m: A maintenance work queue compares alert cutoffs under inspection capacity. A lower cutoff can catch more observed failures while also creating more alerts to inspect.
service-predictive-analytics-learning-re: Aggregate booking history and known calendar events support a range of tutoring demand. Planners use the range for staffing rather than making student eligibility decisions.
service-predictive-analytics-shipment-ar: Shipment ETA intervals are judged on observed coverage and width as separate criteria. Missing tracking data invokes a documented fallback for dispatch.
service-resilient-it-operations: Trace a critical user journey, define a service indicator, and route actionable failure signals to an owner. Rehearse recovery and use the results to revise the runbook.
service-resilient-it-operations-payments: A timed-out payment keeps its stable operation ID. The service checks the authoritative status before any retry and tracks ambiguous outcomes for reconciliation.
service-resilient-it-operations-logistic: The dispatch runbook measures oldest-item age and completions, caps worker concurrency at the carrier boundary, and verifies that retries do not repeat completed work.
service-resilient-it-operations-healthca: The runbook restores a backup to an isolated target, deploys a compatible referral application, and checks representative workflow transitions. It records elapsed recovery time and recoverable data separately.
service-resilient-it-operations-media-al: Group duplicate symptoms from one playback incident into an actionable responder route, keep distinct failure paths, and replay controlled faults before dropping alert coverage.
service-resilient-it-operations-utilitie: The advisory portal compares event time with a freshness threshold and displays timely, delayed, and missing observations differently. Freshness depends on source event time even while the dashboard is healthy.
service-software-engineering: The training cycle moves from an observable requirement through a bounded repository change and risk-based tests to an independently assessed capstone.
service-software-engineering-commerce-id: The order and scoped idempotency record are stored together, so a retry after an ambiguous timeout returns the original order.
service-software-engineering-insurance-r: Agreed pricing fixtures run against the existing rule and the separated calculation, while any approved behavior correction is recorded explicitly.
service-software-engineering-education-a: Keyboard-accessible course selection leads to a server-side eligibility check and a confirmation or a clear correction path that preserves entered values.
service-software-engineering-logistics-q: The exercise compares per-row lookups with a batched query using identical tracking fixtures and verifies that the full history and ordering still match.
service-software-engineering-professiona: An export request carries trusted tenant and resource context to the queued worker, which rechecks permission before writing the artifact. Downloads have their own access check.
deep-reliability-error-budget-accounting: A request-weighted error budget divides total bad events by total eligible events across busy and quiet windows.
deep-reliability-burn-rate-alerts: A long alert window measures sustained error-budget burn. The short window confirms the problem is still active before a page fires.
deep-reliability-retry-load-budget: One retry authority checks repeat safety and a shared attempt budget, then tests completed work against dependency load.
deep-platform-first-deploy-cohorts: An onboarding cohort counts every eligible team, including verified deployments and incomplete attempts observed over the same window.
deep-platform-onboarding-wait-states: A single attempt follows access waiting, active engineering work and build waiting. Its elapsed time follows the dependent path.
deep-platform-golden-path-rollout-gates: A platform pilot compares existing and guided paths within standard and regulated services, then checks safety and rollback conditions.
deep-finops-cost-per-successful-order: Reconciled costs are divided by successful business outcomes. The ledger retains retry costs, and repeated attempts do not count as completed orders.
deep-finops-effective-cost-reconciliatio: Billed cost follows invoice timing. Effective cost follows the relevant charge periods, with each view reconciled to its own source population.
deep-finops-unit-cost-variance-bridge: A spend bridge applies the old unit rate to the new outcome count, isolating the volume effect before comparing actual spend and testing allocation assumptions.
deep-migration-cutover-replay-window: A recorded snapshot leaves a backlog. The target drains it at the durable apply rate minus new arrivals. Cutover also needs time for reconciliation.
deep-migration-partition-reconciliation: Source and target use the same partition and snapshot boundary. Compare keys and canonicalized values, repair discrepancies, and rerun the checks.
deep-migration-recovery-cutover-gates: Before target writes, traffic can return to the authoritative source. After acknowledged target writes, fence writers and reconcile before recovery.
deep-ai-evaluation-claim-level-grounding: A groundedness review keeps the retrieval snapshot and answer together, checks each claim against the supplied evidence, and reports abstention separately.
deep-ai-evaluation-paired-model-evaluati: A paired comparison gives both model versions the same cases and evaluates improvements and regressions on the disagreements.
deep-ai-evaluation-rare-failure-release-: Define an observable failure, estimate an upper bound using independent requests, and stage exposure with monitoring and rollback.
deep-performance-mergeable-latency-perce: Sum counts at matching histogram boundaries before locating the percentile. The enclosing bucket defines the precision of the estimate.
deep-performance-queue-saturation-model: In a one-server queue model, expected response time grows as arrivals approach service capacity. Test the shape with a controlled ramp.
deep-performance-open-loop-load-test: A serial client waits for a response during a stall. An open-loop generator preserves the offered arrival schedule and exposes unsent or dropped work.
deep-networks-mtu-payload-budget: Start from the effective path MTU, subtract IP and TCP headers, then allow for framing when estimating how many application bytes can fit.
deep-networks-network-policy-verificatio: Controlled test workloads check expected allowed and denied traffic, with unexpected successes investigated before promoting a network policy.
deep-networks-allreduce-bandwidth-budget: Algorithm bandwidth uses logical tensor size and duration. Bus bandwidth normalizes collective traffic. End-to-end iteration timing shows whether it matters.
deep-learning-delayed-retrieval-check: A closed-source recall check uses the same rubric after a delay. A separate transfer task tests whether the learner can apply the idea to a new case.
deep-learning-observable-feedback-rubric: Reviewers independently score observable criteria, clarify the rubric from disagreements, and test it on a comparable new task.
deep-learning-team-practice-experiment: A small practice experiment compares a baseline and trial, retaining incomplete reviews and checking work mix and rework before making a local decision.
deep-quantum-circuit-shot-uncertainty: Repeated independent circuit shots estimate a binary event and improve sampling precision. Calibration bias is checked separately.
deep-quantum-readout-calibration: Known prepared states calibrate the readout labels. Use the calibration to correct the raw circuit fraction, retaining both estimates and testing controls.
deep-quantum-logical-error-comparison: An equal per-cycle error rate can yield different whole-run risk at different lengths. Compare logical tests with matched conditions and uncertainty.
